s.g: Any of the genus Ixia of cormous plants native to South Africa.
An indigenous Maya people in El Quiché Department, Guatemala.
(slang) Nothing; nix; often in the phrase "ixnay on ...", indicating something that must not be mentioned, often in Pig Latin
s.x: Ixnay on the "W-A-L-K" while the dogs can hear you.

s.g: (slang, transitive) To reject or cancel something; nix.
A member of the genus Ixodes of ticks.
(botany) Any of the flowering plants in the genus Ixora.
